summary: Master airport operations and ground handling management with practical tools for turnaround control, baggage handling, ramp safety, and KPI reporting.
lede: Airport operations training covers coordinating airside and landside activity to keep aircraft, passengers, baggage and services moving safely and on schedule. Designed for airport operations, ground handling and airline station control professionals, it supports day-to-day turnaround control and disruption response. Learners practise measuring turnaround performance, sequencing ramp services, and tracing baggage exceptions through reconciliation and control checklists.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work in airport operations, ground handling, or airline station control and need sharper tools for day-to-day execution.
modules: Airport Operations and Ground Handling Foundations
prerequisites: You need basic familiarity with airport or ground handling operations, a calculator, and a laptop for exercises using templates and sample data. Prior exposure to turnaround reports, baggage logs, or safety reports will help, but the course starts from intermediate operational practice rather than specialist engineering.
